description: For fence RENTAL companies (construction sites, events, security) rather than installers. Loads rental products priced in dollars per linear foot per period (day / week / month), the minimum term, per-rental gate charges, delivery and setup fees and optional add-ons (privacy screen, sandbag bases). Enables the rental option on the widget; leaves any installed-fence catalog untouched. Ask the company for real numbers; never invent them. Requires org_id and setup_claim from create_contractor_account.

addons.description: optional extras the customer can tick, e.g. "Privacy Screen" -> { price: 1.25, unit: "ft" }

delivery_fee_usd.description: Flat delivery + pickup fee added to every quote; omit for none

drive_gate_usd.description: Flat charge per vehicle gate, per rental

min_term_days.description: Shortest rental accepted, in days (28 = one month)

panel_length_ft.description: Panel length used for per-panel add-ons

rates.description: dollars per linear foot per period; include only the periods the company offers

products.description: product name -> { description?, rates: { day?, week?, month? } }, e.g. "Panel Fence (Freestanding)" -> { rates: { week: 1.75, month: 2.5 } }

rental_only.description: true if the company does NOT install fence: turns the fence module off so the widget shows rental only

setup_fee_usd.description: Setup + removal fee; omit for none

walk_gate_usd.description: Flat charge per pedestrian gate, per rental

name: set_rental_pricing
title: Set temporary fence RENTAL pricing
